paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jesu koi lai mun hiam ah athum a, athum khit in anungzui mi khat in akiang ah, "Toupa, Johan in anungzuite thumdan ahilh bang in hon hilh sam in," achi hi.
heading: Jesu Sinsak, Toupa Thumna / (Mat 6.9-13; 7.7-11)
english: When he finished praying in a certain place, one of his disciples said to him, “Lord, teach us to pray, just as John also taught his disciples.”

paite: Huan ama'n akiang uah, "Na thum chiang un hichibang in na chi ding uh, achi hi: Ka Pa uh, van a om, na min kizahtak hen, na gam hong tung hen.
english: He said to them, “When you pray, say, ‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy. May your Kingdom come. May your will be done on earth, as it is in heaven.

paite: Niteng in ka nek khop uh an hon pia in.
english: Give us day by day our daily bread.

paite: Ka khelhnate uh hon ngaidam in, kou leng kuapeuh bat hon neite ka ngaidam uhi; Khemna ah hon pilut ke'n. Gilou lak ah hon hu zaw in."
english: Forgive us our sins, for we ourselves also forgive everyone who is indebted to us. Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one.’”

paite: Huan akiang uah, "Na lak ua kuahiam in lawm nei henla, zan lai in akiang a hoh in, 'Lawm, tanghou phel thum hon leitawisak ve.
heading: Thum Teitei Ding A Thuhilhna / (Mat 7.7-11; Luk 18.1-8)
english: He said to them, “Which of you, if you go to a friend at midnight and tell him, ‘Friend, lend me three loaves of bread,

paite: Ka lawm zin in ahon tawn a, ama a lui ding bangmah ka nei kei,' chi henla;
english: for a friend of mine has come to me from a journey, and I have nothing to set before him,’

paite: ama'n insung a pan in, 'Hon hihbuai ke'n; tu'n zaw kong khak ahi, ka tate leng ka kiang ah lupna ah a-ihmuta uh; thou in ka hong pe thei kei chi in dawng taleh, ka hon hilh ahi,'
english: and he from within will answer and say, ‘Don’t bother me. The door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed. I can’t get up and give it to you’?

paite: alawm ahih ziak in thou in ava pe kei na a, anget ngutngut ziak in thou in adeih zahzah ava pe ding hi.
english: I tell you, although he will not rise and give it to him because he is his friend, yet because of his persistence, he will get up and give him as many as he needs.

paite: "Huchi in ka hon hilh ahi, 'Ngen un, piak in na om ding uh; zong un, na mu ding uh; kiu un, honsak in na om ding uh.
english: “I tell you, keep asking, and it will be given you. Keep seeking, and you will find. Keep knocking, and it will be opened to you.

paite: Kuapeuh angen in angah a, kuapeuh azong in amu a, akiu peuhmah honsak in a-om ding hi.'
english: For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.

paite: Nou lak a papen, ata in tanghou ngen taleh kua ahia suang pe ding? Ahihleh ngasa ngen taleh kua ahia gul pe ding?
english: “Which of you fathers, if your son asks for bread, will give him a stone? Or if he asks for a fish, he won’t give him a snake instead of a fish, will he?

paite: Ahihkeileh, aktui ngen taleh aikam ape dia hia?
english: Or if he asks for an egg, he won’t give him a scorpion, will he?

paite: Huchi in nou migilou in bawn na tate thil hoih piakdan na theih uleh, na Pa uh van a om in angente Kha Siangthou pe na tel in chia!" achi hi.
english: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him?”

paite: Huan Jesu'n dawi pau thei lou khat adelhkhia hi. Huan hichi ahong hi a, dawi apawttak in pau thei lou ahong pauta; huchi in mipi'n lamdang asa mahmah uhi.
heading: Jesu Leh Beelzibul / (Mat 12.22-32; Mar 3.20-30)
english: He was casting out a demon, and it was mute. When the demon had gone out, the mute man spoke; and the multitudes marveled.

paite: Himahleh akhen in, "Dawimang Beelzibul ziak in ei ve dawite adelhkhiak zel," achi uhi.
english: But some of them said, “He casts out demons by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.”

paite: Akhen in, amah ze-etna ding in, van a kipan chiamtehna angen uhi.
english: Others, testing him, sought from him a sign from heaven.

paite: Ama'n angaihtuah uh athei a, akiang uah, "Koi gam leng amah kidou peuh amangthang a; inkuan khat leng amah kidou amangthang hi.
english: But he, knowing their thoughts, said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation. A house divided against itself falls.

paite: Setan leng amah akidouleh agam bangchi in adingkhe dia? Beelzibul ziak in dawite adelhkhia, na hon chi uh maw;
english: If Satan also is divided against himself, how will his kingdom stand? For you say that I cast out demons by Beelzebul.

paite: ke'n Beelzibul ziak a dawite delhkhia ka hihleh, na tate un kua ziak in ahia adelhkhiak uh? Huaiziak in amau noute hon vai hawmsak dingte ahi ding uh.
english: But if I cast out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.

paite: Himahleh ke'n Pathian khutzung ziak a dawite delhkhia ka hihleh Pathian lalgam na kiang uah ahong tung khinta hi.
english: But if I by God’s finger cast out demons, then God’s Kingdom has come to you.

paite: "Mihat in hiamzat kim tawi a a-inn aven sung teng, asum bittak in a-om gige hi.
english: “When the strong man, fully armed, guards his own dwelling, his goods are safe.

paite: Himahleh amah sang a hatzaw in ahong sual a, azoh chiang in, amuan agalvan kim asut a, sum alaksak a ahawmzak zel hi.
english: But when someone stronger attacks him and overcomes him, he takes from him his whole armor in which he trusted, and divides his plunder.

paite: "Kuapeuh ka lam a pang lou tuh hon dou ahi a, kuapeuh hon lakkhawmpih lou in ahihzak hi.
english: “He who is not with me is against me. He who doesn’t gather with me scatters.

paite: "Dawi nin paimi sung a kipan apawt in, khawlna zong in tui omlouhna mun peuh ah avakvak hi. Huan khawlna himhim amu kei a, ka pawtna inn ah ka kik nawn mai ding," achi hi.
heading: Dawi Nin Kik Nawnna Mihing / (Mat 12.43-45)
english: The unclean spirit, when he has gone out of the man, passes through dry places, seeking rest; and finding none, he says, ‘I will turn back to my house from which I came out.’

paite: Ava tun in phiatsiang leh zephoih in amu hi.
english: When he returns, he finds it swept and put in order.

paite: Huaitak in ava pai a, amah sang a gilouzaw dawi dang sagih ahon pi a, huai mi sung ah alut ua, ateng uhi. "Huai mihing omdan nanung, amasa sang in ahoih kei zaw tham hi," achi hi.
english: Then he goes and takes seven other spirits more evil than himself, and they enter in and dwell there. The last state of that man becomes worse than the first.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai thute agen lai in, mipi lak ah numei khat akikoukhia a, akiang ah, "Nang hon painu gil leh, nang hon vaktu nawi ahampha e,” achi hi.
heading: Hamphatna Dik
english: It came to pass, as he said these things, a certain woman out of the multitude lifted up her voice and said to him, “Blessed is the womb that bore you, and the breasts which nursed you!”

paite: Ama'n bel, "Pathian thu za a zuite mihampha ahi zaw uh," achi hi.
english: But he said, “On the contrary, blessed are those who hear the word of God, and keep it.”

paite: Huan mipite akiang a ahong kikhop lai un, Jesu'n, "Hiai khang giloute ahi uh; chiamtehna azong ua; himahleh Jonah chiamtehna chih louh akiang uah chiamtehna piak ahi kei ding.
heading: Chiamtehna Zon Louh Ding / (Mat 12.38-42)
english: When the multitudes were gathering together to him, he began to say, “This is an evil generation. It seeks after a sign. No sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah the prophet.

paite: Nineveh a mite a dia chiamtehna Jonah ahih bang in, Mihing Tapa leng hiai khangte chiamtehna ahong hi ding hi.
english: For even as Jonah became a sign to the Ninevites, so the Son of Man will also be to this generation.

paite: Thukhen ni chiang in, Simlam kumpinu hiai khangte kiang ah adingh dia, siam louh atangsak ding; Solomon pilna ngaikhe ding in kawlmong a kipan ahong ngal a; ngai un, Solomon sang a thupizaw hiai ah a-om hi.
english: The Queen of the South will rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation and will condemn them, for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, one greater than Solomon is here.

paite: Thukhen ni chiang in, Nineveh khua a mite hiai khangte kiang ah adingh ding ua, siam louh atangsak ding uh, Jonah thuhilh ziak in akisik ngal ua; ngai un, Jonah sang a thupizaw hiai ah a-om hi.
english: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation, and will condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, one greater than Jonah is here.

paite: "Kuamah in khawnvak akimu lou ding in asel kei a, loh nuai ah leng akoih ngei sam kei uh, alut mite'n vak amuhtheihna ding un akoihna ah akoih zel uhi.
heading: Khawnvak A Pan Sinsakna / (Mat 5.15; 6.22-23)
english: “No one, when he has lit a lamp, puts it in a cellar or under a basket, but on a stand, that those who come in may see the light.

paite: Na pumpi khawnvak na mit ahi; na mit achiimleh na pumpi leng avek in avaksuak nak hi; achiim keileh bel na pumpi amial vek nak hi.
english: The lamp of the body is the eye. Therefore when your eye is good, your whole body is also full of light; but when it is evil, your body also is full of darkness.

paite: Huchi in na sung a vak om mial ana hi kha ding e, pilvang in.
english: Therefore see whether the light that is in you isn’t darkness.

paite: Huchi in na pumpi koi lai peuh mial lou a, avek a avakkhiakleh khawnvak vak petpet in atatvak bang in avakkhe vek ding," achi hi.
english: If therefore your whole body is full of light, having no part dark, it will be wholly full of light, as when the lamp with its bright shining gives you light.”

paite: Huan agen lai in Pharisai khat in amah kiang a an ne ding in achial a; huchi in alut a an ane hi.
heading: Pharisaite Leh Laigelhmite Demna / (Mat 23.1-36; Mar 12.38-40)
english: Now as he spoke, a certain Pharisee asked him to dine with him. He went in and sat at the table.

paite: Pharisai in an um amuh in, an nek ma a khut asil louh lamdang asa mahmah hi.
english: When the Pharisee saw it, he marveled that he had not first washed himself before dinner.

paite: Toupa'n akiang ah, "Nou Pharisaite'n nou leh kuang polam na silsiang ngeitak ua; na sunglam uh lah lepgukna leh gilou in adim hi.
english: The Lord said to him, “Now you Pharisees cleanse the outside of the cup and of the platter, but your inward part is full of extortion and wickedness.

paite: Mihaite aw, polam bawlpa'n sunglam leng abawl kei a hia?
english: You foolish ones, didn’t he who made the outside make the inside also?

paite: Himahleh na neihte uh migenthei kiang a thilthawnpiak ding in zang un; huchi in ngai un, nou a ding in bangkim asiang vek hi.
english: But give for gifts to the needy those things which are within, and behold, all things will be clean to you.

paite: "Nou Pharisaite aw, na tung uh agik e; pudina, pardi leh anteh-louhing teng sawm-a-khat na pia ua, diktatna leh Pathian itna na limsak kei uhi; himahleh huaite ei ve na hih ding uh, adangte hih lou tuan lou in.
english: But woe to you Pharisees! For you tithe mint and rue and every herb, but you bypass justice and God’s love. You ought to have done these, and not to have left the other undone.

paite: Nou Pharisaite aw, na tung uh agik e! Sinagog ah tutphah hoihpente leh dawr mun a chibai bukte na ngaisang uh.
english: Woe to you Pharisees! For you love the best seats in the synagogues and the greetings in the marketplaces.

paite: Laigelhmite leh Pharisai lepchiahte, na tung uh agik hi! Han chiamteh louh, atung a thei lou a mi apaina zel bang na hi uh," achi hi.
english: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like hidden graves, and the men who walk over them don’t know it.”

paite: Huan dan thei mi khat in akiang ah, "Sinsakpa, hiai thu na gen kou leng hon tai na hi," chi in adawng hi.
english: One of the lawyers answered him, “Teacher, in saying this you insult us also.”

paite: Huan ama'n, "Dan thei mite aw, nou leng na tung uh agik! Puakgik, puak haksa pipi mite na suan ua, nou lah huai puakgikte na khutzung khat un leng na khoih ngei kei uh.
english: He said, “Woe to you lawyers also! For you load men with burdens that are difficult to carry, and you yourselves won’t even lift one finger to help carry those burdens.

paite: Na tung uh agik! Na pipute uh thahsa zawlneite han inn na lam ngal ua.
english: Woe to you! For you build the tombs of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.

paite: Huchi in na pipute uh thilhihte na theihpih un na hoihsakpih uh ahi; amau athat ua, nou ahan innte na lam uhi.
english: So you testify and consent to the works of your fathers. For they killed them, and you build their tombs.

paite: Huaiziak in 'Pathian pilna in leng, akiang uah zawlneite leh sawltakte ka sawl dia, akhen athat ding ua, akhen asawi ding uh,' achi hi.
english: Therefore also the wisdom of God said, ‘I will send to them prophets and apostles; and some of them they will kill and persecute,

paite: Zawlnei tengteng sisan, leitung pian tung a kipan a kisuah, hiai khangte tung ah phu alak theih ding in achi hi.
english: that the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation,

paite: Abel sisan suah a kipan, Zakariah, maitam leh tempul kikal a sisan suah tan in; ahi, ka hon hilh ahi, hiai khangte tung ah phu akila ding.
english: from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zachariah, who perished between the altar and the sanctuary.’ Yes, I tell you, it will be required of this generation.

paite: Nou dan theite aw, na tung uh agik e! Theihna chabi na paimangpih ua; nou lah na lut ngal kei ua, mi alut dingte na dal uhi,” achi hi.
english: Woe to you lawyers! For you took away the key of knowledge. You didn’t enter in yourselves, and those who were entering in, you hindered.”

paite: Huai a kipan apawt in, lai-gelhmite leh Pharisaite'n amah atawng ua, thu chiteng gensak teitei tum in leh,
english: As he said these things to them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to be terribly angry, and to draw many things out of him,

paite: apaukhelh zenzenleh mat tum in atang gige uhi.
english: lying in wait for him, and seeking to catch him in something he might say, that they might accuse him.
